test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Statements:

All sculptures are art.

Some art is ancient.

No ancient object is replaceable.

Conclusions:

I. Some sculptures may not be replaceable.

II. All art is replaceable.
solution:
Least possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a163260d941247bf6be6932d985db139cc2418f07055dbd805de0c79760ca878.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a66c2c76a16aa91bdda2055aa7ace503c0d112ba0afeae5ebdcf63e83088a276.png] 

Conclusions:**

I. Some sculptures may not be replaceable →** Follow **(All sculptures are art and some art is ancient and No ancient object is replaceable. so, Some sculptures may not be replaceable).

II. All art is replaceable → **Does not follow **(There is no direct relation given between art and replaceable. so it is possible not definite).

Only I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 1**”.
